summary: 1935 CCC-built Aermotor lookout in Yuba County, staffed by volunteers since 1992; NHLR-registered 2019; current staffing unconfirmed after 2021.

facts.design: 60-foot Aermotor Company tower with a 7x7 observation cabin; station buildings built by the CCC
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection - Nevada-Yuba-Placer Unit (Cal Fire NEU)

staffing.status: volunteer (VIP) fire-season staffing; 2021 volunteer call warned of seasonal shutdown

access.note: Public access restricted by a neighboring private scout campground (NHLR); station 2.2 miles from paved road (1991 survey)

visit.trail_note: Station 2.2 miles from paved road; access restricted by a neighboring private campground (NHLR)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the site has been a fire detection point since 1921 and gives 1935 as the build year for the present station, built by the CCC. These are not in conflict; both are recorded.

notes_for_editor: Brief record confirmed: 1935 build, standing, Cal Fire NEU agency. Current staffing is not confirmed past the 2021 volunteer call. The YouTube link in the brief was not read. Access restricted to the public per NHLR; the brief's access 'unknown' is replaced accordingly.
